summary: MFK Almenefonden offers funding for projects aligned with the foundation's purpose. Applicants must submit applications during the specific application periods, including a detailed project description, timeline, budget, and CVs of involved personnel. Changes in the project or application must be communicated proactively, and the foundation reserves the right to request additional information.
eligible_applicants: Individuals or groups whose projects align with the foundation's purpose
activity_types: Innovative initiatives in line with fund's objectives
reporting_requirements: Applicants must notify the foundation of any receipt of other funding before application processing
Must report any changes in the project or application information proactively
The foundation may request additional information during the process
